The three essential moments

The heart of the demo.

Explore a sample, bring the documents, then experience the three steps that make Retrosum useful.

03

Read every detail accurately.

Eight viewable PDFs: invoices, bills, receipts and multipage records in different layouts, including one genuinely handwritten receipt. Target zero numeric errors on the evaluated demo documents; uncertain figures stay out of totals until reviewed.

04

See a beautiful money picture.

Smooth animated charts, clear KPIs and useful comparisons. Hover for precise values. Click or tap to explore the records, then open the original source.

05

Work with Retro.

Ask for a summary, take a guided tour, understand a chart, or create and edit session records. Retro scrolls, highlights and fills editable forms. Confirm a change, then Undo it from the conversation.

The full app adds cash movement, open-item ageing, customer/vendor breakdowns and source drawers. Every trend comes from viewable PDF records, including the multipage August pack. Smooth motion stays part of the experience; no animation-off setting.

Your session assistant

Meet Retro.
More than a chat box.

Retro summarizes your records, explains the dashboard and gives a short guided tour. It can also prepare invoices, expenses, payment records and contacts from a plain-language request.

Watch Retro scroll to a chart, outline a field, and fill an editable form. Confirm once, and the records, charts and export update together. A small Undo restores the latest action. Refresh preserves this workspace; Reset or a proposed two-hour expiry ends it.

New invoices begin as drafts. Issuing and recording payment are separate. Originals are retained only in temporary browser storage; live AI processing sends the required content to OpenAI, without a server upload library.

Invoices

Customer, dates, service lines, currency, explicit tax and draft/issued state.

Payment records

Amount, movement date and direction; link to an invoice or bill.

Customers & vendors

Simple names and roles; optional contact details. No long setup form.

The same proven project backbone

A focused, complete demo.

ClipBuilder and ScreenPilot inform the folder structure, engineering boundaries and deployment approach.

The shared foundation

Next.js/React frontend, Express API, shared validated contracts and one money engine. Public frontend and private backend on Google Cloud Run. OpenAI is selected, with GPT-6.1 Sol as the initial evaluated candidate. The normal sample runs live; labelled development fakes keep local iteration usable without the API.

pnpmTypeScriptZodDockerCloud RunRefresh-safe browser CRUD

The design direction

Green and burnt orange from the logo, ivory text and complementary chart colors. Vintage headings with a clean financial interface: proposed Fraunces + IBM Plex Sans. Calm photo hero, rich dashboard interaction.

Brand warmth, clear data.
Accuracy, templates and planning

We will author fictional documents informed by common FreshBooks, Vertex42 and spreadsheet layouts. One genuinely handwritten synthetic receipt belongs inside the normal eight-PDF bundle. The other originals use varied professional printed/scanned layouts, and every comparison record is viewable. Live release requires zero incorrect numeric transcriptions on the published evaluated corpus, with ambiguity held for review. This is an acceptance target, not achieved OCR performance or a promise about every upload.

The blueprint specifies every KPI, chart interaction, core field, command, API boundary, resource limit, evaluation gate and release step. This brief previews intended behavior. Twelve detailed tickets now define the implementation. They are all Planned; no app feature or live OCR evidence is completed by this brief.
